about: Inkling-2-Mini (Thinking Machines' own checkpoint) on mlx-dspark with MTP-head and prompt-lookup speculative decoding. The attention projections and output head are quantized to 8-bit at load (--target-bits 8; about 1.6% of next-token choices differ from the released bf16, all near-ties; the experts stay as released). 32,768-token window (enforced with --context-window), up to 4 concurrent requests, text only. The fork's kernels and flags (FP16 activations, NVFP4 NAMP, MMA shared-prefix attention, snapshot certificate) are env-gated and pinned in this launch; mlx is built from ml-explore/mlx@5c89894 (0.32.5 dev, after v0.32.4). Measured on an M2 Max 64 GB (30-core GPU, AC power): 47.6 tok/s on gBench serving (512 in, 128 out), 43.1 tok/s single-request agent decode, 50.0 tok/s aggregate across 4 streams at a 23.5K shared prefix (33-34 GiB). A 50,019-token needle was found 3/3 at 43.0 GiB peak, beyond the 32K window this recipe declares. HumanEval+ against the same engine's stock baseline: 92.1% vs 93.3% (164 problems, greedy, 4,096-token cap, one run) with 40.9% faster decode.
install: python3 -m pip install 'mlx-dspark @ git+https://github.com/maxmilneaus/mlx-dspark.git@8778b25296943f3f835fa28e38536efd4dcbf064' 'mlx @ git+https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx.git@5c89894465a9a010bc81109b646207bbfed84c4d' mlx-lm==0.32.2 'mlx-vlm @ git+https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm.git@d998a6207b7dc613b52618646dbea13a4799f7ca' transformers==5.24.0 huggingface_hub==2.4.0 numpy==2.5.5 (macOS on Apple silicon, Python >= 3.10; building mlx needs the Xcode command line tools, cmake and the Metal toolchain)
